cues: Meet ReallyWise Property Expert.
A 24/7 AI expert for every listing. It answers buyers, books viewings, and hands you the lead.
Getting started takes under a minute.
Paste your listing link. Property Expert reads the listing, generates your QR code, and prepares your yard sign.
Every home starts as a private draft, so you review what it found first.
Conflicting facts, Fair Housing wording, and the key facts buyers ask about.
Then publish.
Property Expert answers only from what it knows about this home.
Public data syncs automatically: MLS, county records and taxes, schools, flood maps, and recent nearby sales.
Add your documents and notes, and choose who sees each one.
Your guidance is repeated word for word.
Then share it everywhere.
Every listing gets its own link and QR code, for yard signs, flyers, open house sign-ins, social posts, and your website.
Each channel is tracked, so you know what works.
On their side, buyers just scan or click, with no app and no login.
They say what kind of buyer they are, and ask anything.
Every answer comes from the listing documents, with the source right there.
The HOA, the roof, the schools nearby.
And if the answer isn't in the data, it says so, and asks you.
When they're ready, it books a private showing.
You get the lead the moment it happens.
Every buyer chat lands in one inbox, with the ones who need you on top.
See how close each buyer is, what they told us, and how they found the home.
Want to step in? Pause the assistant and take over the chat, any time.
Questions it couldn't answer come straight to you.
Answer once, and Property Expert uses your answer from then on.
Showing requests follow your showing hours and sync with your calendar.
Set offer instructions once. The assistant repeats them exactly, and never gives advice.
And when something changes, notify every interested buyer in one click.
Your pipeline moves forward from the chats,
and Insights show where buyers came from, and what they ask most.
Keep sellers in the loop with weekly interest reports. Counts only, no buyer names.
A scan starts the conversation.
ReallyWise turns it into a booked viewing.
